jobs.title: Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
We believe a story can change what a person can see: not by arguing, but by showing them something true they didn’t have words for. Dream Three is a story studio built to deliver best\-in\-class, genre\-spanning narratives across mediums, including film and series, theater and live events, publishing and music, and digital and immersive. If you’re looking for a team that takes big creative swings and doesn’t settle for less than excellent, keep reading.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**
=================


We believe in the power of story. Dream Three is a multi\-platform story studio built to deliver best\-in\-class, genre\-spanning narratives across media, including film and series, theater and live events, publishing and music, and digital and immersive. If you’re looking for a team that takes bold, creative swings and doesn’t settle for less than excellent, keep reading.


We’re hiring an Operations Coordinator to keep business operations running smoothly and to provide executive support to our CEO and leadership by coordinating people, paperwork, and follow\-through on creative projects and talent engagements. You’ll step into established workflows, receive clear direction, and have room to improve processes as you build ownership. The role starts part\-time, with potential for expanded hours and broader operational responsibility.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================

* Deadlines, decisions, and next steps are clear; routine work reaches completion without repeated prompting.
* Agreements, financial paperwork, schedules, and records are accurate, organized, and ready for review.
* You resolve routine issues, communicate early when priorities conflict, and protect leadership’s time.

**WHO YOU ARE**
===============

* You enjoy making systems work. You are precise, resourceful, discreet, and comfortable following up with people at every level.
* You close loops. You don’t confuse sending a reminder with resolving an issue.
* You turn ambiguity into clarity by implementing workable plans without creating unnecessary bureaucratic fiction.
* You stay calm when priorities change and take pride in making ambitious creative work possible.
* You welcome direct feedback, take responsibility for your work, and stay effective when deadlines and priorities shift.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

* **Operations \+ Projects:** Maintain tasks, deadlines, and trackers; translate decisions into assigned actions and coordinate administrative handoffs with project teams and partners.
* **Executive Support:** Coordinate scheduling, meeting preparation, designated correspondence, and approved business travel; organize decisions and follow\-up for the CEO.
* **Financial Administration:** Collect and check invoices, receipts, and vendor documents; route approvals, maintain status records, and follow up with the bookkeeper and appropriate partners.
* **Contracts \+ Bookings:** Prepare deal memos and booking documents from approved templates and confirmed terms; coordinate review, signatures, deadlines, and booking logistics.
* **Systems \+ Documentation:** Keep assigned records and instructions current, run established workflows, and propose practical improvements.

**ROLE REQUIREMENTS**
=====================

* Relevant experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, or business administration—typically 1–3 years; equivalent practical experience is welcome.
* Evidence of accurate follow\-through, professional writing, sound judgment, and ownership of recurring work.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, document preparation, task tracking, and learning new systems. Entertainment\-specific processes can be learned; attention to detail and dependability are essential.

**TOOLS YOU’LL USE**
====================


Asana, Airtable, Slack, Dropbox, Word/Excel, DocuSign, and designated business\-administration tools. Experience with comparable platforms is welcome.

**PLUSES**
==========


Entertainment or talent\-representation experience; familiarity with contracts, deal memos, financial paperwork, multiple business entities, or process documentation.

**ADDITIONAL DETAILS**
======================

* **Employment:** Part\-time, hourly, nonexempt W\-2 employee.
* **Pay:** $25–$35/hour overall. Starting pay reflects demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and work location.
* **Hours:** Initially \~25 hours per week during standard business hours, M\-F 10am \- 6pm ET. May require some evenings \+ weekends as projects and business needs require.
* **Location \+ Travel:** Remote (U.S.) and Hybrid (NYC/LA) candidates are welcome. Occasional business travel may be required.
* **Start Date:** As soon as mutually agreed; reasonable notice periods accommodated.
* **Benefits \+ Support:** Reimbursement for preapproved education relevant to your role.
* **Application:** Apply through Ashby with your résumé and one brief example of a recurring operational workflow you personally owned. No cover letter is required.


If this role feels like a stretch in all the right ways, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us how your skills, experience, and unique point of view can level up this team and the stories we’re bringing into the world.


Dream Three is an equal opportunity employer. We value a wide range of backgrounds, identities, and perspectives, and strongly encourage candidates from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

jobs.description:
At Archive, we believe great products should live many lives. We build the technology that powers branded resale for some of the world's most beloved companies, including Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, Dr. Martens, Peloton, and 50\+ others. Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.


The secondhand market is growing three times faster than traditional retail and is projected to reach $350B globally by 2028\. We're building the infrastructure behind that shift, helping brands turn resale into a meaningful part of their business and helping consumers rethink how they shop. If you're excited to change consumer behavior for the better, we'd love to meet you.

**About the role…**
-------------------


We're looking for a Business Development Representative who will both personally drive meaningful new pipeline *and* work with the broader team to level up how our entire outbound engine runs. This is a rare blend of individual contribution and process innovation.


You'll carry a personal pipeline target and partner closely across our sales and marketing teams. Together, you will own our top\-of\-funnel strategy and goals. Just as importantly, you'll partner to reinvent how we prospect — bringing an AI\-first mindset to sourcing, research, messaging, and workflow so that our small team punches well above its weight. This role reports directly to the Head of Marketing \& RevOps and is fully remote, if located in Austin \- we would expect you to come into our local coworking space 2 days a week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


This is the top of Archive's revenue engine. Every new logo we win — Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance — started with someone opening the door. That's this role.

* **Own the number.** You'll carry a personal pipeline generation target and be jointly accountable with the team for the net new number overall — forecasting opportunity creation, calling it accurately, and keeping the team on pace.
* **Build relationships with world\-class brands.** You'll research, account plan, and open opportunities with an elite list of household names. We value depth over breadth: roughly 30 accounts a quarter, worked properly, beats a thousand sprayed sequences.
* **Rebuild how we prospect, with AI.** This is the half of the job that compounds. You'll use AI and LLMs to redesign how we source, research, prioritize, personalize, and sequence — testing, iterating, and doubling down on what works. The goal isn't efficiency, it's leverage: a motion where you and the team put out the quality *and* the volume of a 3\+ person BDR team, without losing the craft that makes outreach actually convert.
* **Own the data and inform the stack.** Everything tracked, documented, and flowing cleanly between tools. You'll demo new tools and make the call on what we add, consolidate, or cut. There are more tools than ever before, but the real magic is in your ability to creatively leverage these tools and know when to just show up as a human.
* **Partner across the go\-to\-market team.** You'll work directly with the sales and marketing team as well as partnering with other teams across the org— refining the end\-to\-end sales process, building the prospecting workflow, and making sure the outreach engine is aimed at the right brands and capturing the right signals.
* **Build momentum.** You'll help shape our sales norms as the team grows, and take on — or invent — the projects that help Archive grow. It's normal to have never built a motion like this before, you won’t be building it alone and we care more that you want to.

* You have 1\-2\+ years of sales development / outbound experience
* You've personally been a top\-performing BDR/SDR and still love the craft of opening opportunities — you take pride in crafting campaigns and writing emails that convert.

* Own a book of Division 8 distributors and run their weekly calls

* Turn what you hear into requirements the engineers ship the following week
* Watch account health, catch low usage early, and pull accounts back before they churn
* Figure out how customer success works at 50 and 100 customers: cohort trainings, office hours, videos, in\-product help. Whatever keeps the signal of a weekly call without 40 hours of meetings

* 3\+ years in Division 8: estimating, detailing, project management, or inside sales
* Hands\-on use of at least one of Comsense, AVAware, eMullion, ProTech, or TOAD
* Read door schedules, hardware sets, and specs without help

* Don't mind schlep. We are regularly knee\-deep in schlep

  

Bonus points (if any)

* DHI coursework, DHT, or AHC
* Have used Bild AI or another AI takeoff tool
* Have trained other estimators or new hires
* Are impact\-driven

  

Message with

* Why we're a fit
* The ERP you have fought with the most, and how you won
* Your favorite fruit (mine is Sitaphal)
* (Please keep it short)

  

Interview Process

* 15\-30 min intro
* 1\-2 hour interview
* 2\-3 day paid work trial with real customers

  

Logistics

* SF\-based or willing to relocate (we'll help)
* Travel 2\-4 trips a month
* Full time


Compensation Range: $70K \- $140K
